paragraphs: The stock price of Fermi Inc. is 5.62 as of 2026-08-24, representing a decrease of 5.07% from the prior close and 22.27% over the past 21 trading sessions. There has been one new news item in the last 24 hours.

Fermi Inc. has been in the news recently, with a headline from Stocktwits quoting cofounder Toby Neugebauer as saying the market "Clearly Wants" cooperation between him and the company's board, amid a surge in the stock price.

There have been various SEC filings recently, including a Form 4 filing on 2026-08-18, a Form 10-Q filing on 2026-08-14, and two 8-K filings on 2026-08-13, one of which announced the appointment of Lee McIntire as the new Chief Executive Officer.
